name: VDGS JDL 2026 R6
description: The Japan Drone League 2026 Round 6 race site at Kawada Park, Toyota, Japan, reconstructed from Saqoosha's own DJI Avata 2 FPV footage, with the sky photographed on the same flight. The sky needs the VDGS mod from 2026-09-23 or later: update this app, then reinstall the mod. No collision yet, so gates and ground are flown through.
author: Saqoosha
